name: JSEARCH_API_KEY
description:
Optional — only needed if a personal project's sourcing_method is "api".
api_provider/apiProvider picks which authorized job-search API is used
(registry default or per-call override — see jobs/sourcing/api/resolver.ts);
jsearch (OpenWebNinja's Job Search API, via API.market) is the only
provider today. Verified live against a real API.market request/response —
JSEARCH_API_KEY is sent as the x-api-market-key header.

name: JSEARCH_BASE_URL
description:
Optional — only needed if a personal project's sourcing_method is "api".
api_provider/apiProvider picks which authorized job-search API is used
(registry default or per-call override — see jobs/sourcing/api/resolver.ts);
jsearch (OpenWebNinja's Job Search API, via API.market) is the only
provider today. Verified live against a real API.market request/response —
JSEARCH_API_KEY is sent as the x-api-market-key header.

name: SITE_SESSIONS_DIR
description:
Optional — only needed if a personal project's sourcing_method is
"scraping", or its strategy is "scrapeAll". A directory of saved
Playwright storage-state files, one per site, named "<hostname>.json"
(e.g. "linkedin.com.json") — resolved by the URL's hostname at the point
of use (see integrations/site_sessions.ts), not a single fixed site.
(Revised — this used to be LINKEDIN_STORAGE_STATE_PATH, a single path,
which made no sense for scrapeAll's genuinely multi-site crawling.) A
site with no matching file proceeds unauthenticated rather than erroring.

name: SERPAPI_API_KEY
description:
Optional — only needed if a personal project's strategy is "scrapeAny",
and only for whichever search_provider it's configured to use (registry
default or per-call override — see jobs/discovery/scrapeAny.ts). Set
either or both; each provider is independent.

serpapi: SerpAPI wraps Google's SERP as structured JSON. Get a key at
https://serpapi.com/manage-api-key.

name: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
description:
claude_web_search: Anthropic's server-side web_search tool does the
actual searching — no separate search vendor, but it calls Anthropic's
Messages API directly (not through LITELLM_VIRTUAL_KEY/LITELLM_PROXY_URL),
so it needs its own key from https://console.anthropic.com/.

name: EXTENSION_API_KEY
description:
Optional — only needed to expose the Chrome extension's lookup endpoint
(GET /personal-projects/:project/applications, heyitschloe/extensions).
Deliberately separate from ORCHESTRATOR_SHARED_SECRET, since the
extension's code/storage is inspectable in a way a server env var isn't.
The endpoint isn't mounted at all while this is unset.

name: THE_STORE_OWNER
description:
Optional — completed job applications are appended as CSV rows to a
separate repo ("the-store"), not agent-ops itself. Unset until that repo
exists; appends are skipped (with a warning log) while unset, not a hard
failure. See integrations/the_store.ts.

name: APPLICANT_FIRST_NAME
description:
Optional as a whole (gated by the five required fields below all being
set) — background the drafting model reads from so formFields/
applicationSummary/resume/coverLetter answer truthfully instead of
inventing the applicant's identity or history. Entirely separate from
resume_source/cover_letter_source (registry) — those control what
document the *output* contains; these control what the model *knows*
about the applicant while drafting. See integrations/google_drive.ts.

name: APPLICANT_RESUME_GDRIVE_LINK
description:
A Google Drive link to the applicant's actual resume, shared as "Anyone
with the link can view" — fetched live as text on every request (once
per request, not per-candidate), no credential needed since the link is
public. Works for a native Google Doc (exported as plain text) or an
uploaded PDF (downloaded and parsed); .docx and other formats aren't
supported. A fetch failure is logged and drafting proceeds without it,
not a hard failure.
